name: CodeTaste
description: A benchmark of refactoring tasks mined from large-scale multi-file changes in open-source repositories to evaluate LLMs' ability to perform behavior-preserving program transformations that improve code structure and maintainability.
reputation: A new, specialized benchmark from the paper introducing CodeTaste; it is not yet widely established as a community standard.
notes: Combines repository test suites with static checks using dataflow reasoning; highlights gap in LLMs' ability to discover human refactorings.
